semantics.action: kind MOVE plus dx/dy; CLICK plus x/y; NOOP. Only relevant accessors return Some
semantics.background: most frequent palette color; tie lowest
semantics.fold: threads explicit accumulator; list snapshot is immutable
semantics.is_blocked: outside bounds or nonbackground destination excluding own old cells
semantics.objects: 4-connected same-color components excluding background, discovered y/x scan on argument grid
semantics.state: four keys k0..k3, bounded Offset values, reset{} per episode; false uses_memory requires empty input/output State
semantics.translate: clear original visible cells with inferred background then paint translated cells; clip outside and allow overwrite
